# montecarlo_azure_data_factory_credentials (Data Source)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credentials_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `app_client_id` (String) Client ID of the Entra ID app registration Monte Carlo signs in with.
- `connection_type` (String) The connection type the credentials are for, such as `snowflake`. Fixed once created.
- `created_time` (String) When the credentials were created.
- `factory_name` (String) Name of the data factory.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the credentials.
- `resource_group_name` (String) Resource group that holds the data factory.
- `storage_type` (String) Where the secret lives. Fixed once created.
- `subscription_id` (String) Azure subscription that holds the data factory.
- `tenant_id` (String) Microsoft Entra ID tenant the data factory belongs to.
